full_page.content:
1946, September 17
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solarus Casey, O. F.M. Cap.
Saint Felix Capuchin Friary Huntington, Indiana September 17th, 1946
"O all ye works of the Lord !... Praise and Exalt Him ... "
God bless you Miss Krausman - you and yours.
Many thanks for your kind favor of the 5th. I hope you are feeling better by this time. It seems to me your apathy regarding glasses is uncalled for ..... As long as I can remember I was inclined to think that, in many cases, glasses quite improved the appearance of the wearer. I would not doubt this could easily apply to M.K.
Thanks be to God I was surprized at looking at your letter today, I could read it nicely without glasses. I started to a Chiropractor in July - two treatments a week and I am feeling improved all round. My Dr. in Detroit who put me on my feet in one month - after trying M.Ds. for years - was Dr. R. N. Schorn ( Chiropractor) of 10050 Connor Ave. - just across Gratiot from the Air Port. He positively helped quite a few patients I sent him - even when almost blind. If you go to him .... Best regards !. .God bless you now and be grateful to God .... Don't worry . ...
Fr. Solanus
